style: Minimalist Scandinavian style: light white-oak floor, warm white walls, white ceiling, matte black and natural wood accents, linen and wool textiles in white, beige and soft grey, a few green plants. Soft natural daylight from a large window. Photorealistic real-estate interior photograph, eye-level wide-angle shot from a corner of the room, showing the floor, two walls and the ceiling. Uncluttered: every piece of furniture stands on its own with clear space around it, nothing overlapping. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
sameHouse: The reference photo shows another room of the same house. Keep exactly the same floor, wall and ceiling finishes, window style, light, colour palette and furniture style, and the same camera height and lens.
